newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via 14-day system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via 14-day system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to add reserves to the banking system via a round of 14-day system repurchase agreements Thursday, analysts said.
In the new maintenance period, which begins this session, the Fed's add need is seen jumping to about $13.5 billion in the first week and $14.5 billion a day in the second week.
Analysts noted that a 14-day system RP is already in place from last Thursday and that another 14-day would be a supplement through year-end.
Fed funds were trading slightly above target at 5-5/16 percent. -- Steven Scheer, N.A. Treasury Desk, 212-859-1867
